title: SpiderWire EZ Braid

seoDescription: Compare original EZ Braid Moss Green labels: 10, 15, 20 and 30 lb with .18-.30 mm diameters and 110-yard packages. No regional chart substitution.
excerpt: This guide follows the original blue EZ Braid Moss Green package labels for 10, 15, 20 and 30 lb. These undated package photographs are the diameter source; the different kg-rated European catalog range is not combined with them.
